facts.label: Rodeio
facts.sub: O rodeio é um show típico do Texas e do Oeste americano. Vaqueiros montam cavalos e touros, e o público torce em uma arena redonda.

facts.label: Chapéus e botas
facts.sub: Muitos visitantes usam chapéu e botas de couro para entrar no clima. Não é obrigatório, mas deixa a noite mais divertida.

pages.title: Boots and hats · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a warm evening in Houston, Texas. A big crowd walks toward a round arena. Rosa wears a hat and boots for the first time. She smells popcorn and hears loud music. A man in a big hat waves at the gate. His name is Cal.
“Howdy! Welcome to the rodeo!” says Cal. “Hi! This is our first rodeo.” says Rosa. “Great! Do you like horses?” says Cal.

pages.title: Boots and hats · 3/3
paragraphs: “Can we take pictures?” says Rosa. “Sure! Have fun tonight!” says Cal. Rosa and her friends find seats near the fence. A cowboy rides a wild horse and the crowd cheers. They eat corn dogs and drink cold lemonade. At the end, fireworks light up the sky. Rosa takes many pictures for her family. A first time is a memory for life.
